mission: Update Luke on the crisis without triggering institutional intervention that would complicate an already impossible situation.
why_now: The seal is deteriorating faster post-sabotage. Ben must update Luke but the full truth would trigger institutional intervention that could make things worse. The irony of his information curation is peaking.
conflict: Ben vs. compounding pressure of a crisis he can't contain
turning_point: Torin confronts Ben: 'You're curating reality to manage the outcome you want. You know who else did that?' Ben is falling into the pattern he's trying to break.
emotional_trajectory: Even the person trying to break the pattern falls into it under pressure
notes: Ben withholds full truth from Luke — tactical but ironic. Veraine confirmed heading to Veranthos with complete calibration data. Ruusan's Valley of the Jedi affected. Torin confronts Ben about his own pattern of information curation.
